description: Vulnerabilities deliberately planted in this app. The benchmark checks the scanner finds each one (rule + file) and counts any other finding of severity medium or higher as a false positive. Low/info findings are reported separately.

planted.note: service role key in a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable ships to every browser
Stripe live secret key in source
orders table has no row level security
profiles readable by anyone, including emails
logged-in user can read anyone's order
no auth + admin client + id from the body: anyone can use another user's stored API key (pattern found in a real open-source app)
OpenAI on the owner's key with no login check and no rate limit (denial of wallet)

safe_lookalikes: lib/firebase.ts (Firebase web API keys are public by design: info only)
comments table policy (any logged-in user can read comments: info only)
lib/actions.ts ('use server' action using the admin client, imported by a client component)
app/api/summarize/route.ts (AI call with login, per-user rate limit and output cap)
app/api/translate/route.ts (uses the user's own API key: info only)
app/api/vision/route.ts (user's own Gemini key passed positionally; an unrelated SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must not count as 'owner pays': info only)
